equations.note: The generalized Chaos Game / Hutchinson operator, Eq. (5.1) of Barnsley et al. 1988. Visually verified against page-239.png: candidate 9a6f946c-5297-5399-b7d5-424821f68aae (node 38936517-77d1-5fe7-8ce3-cb57338f874c).

Fig. 5.3's single contractive affine map ('puts the eyes closer together') — one illustrative w_i, not the unlisted N=5 set behind Fig. 5.4. Visually verified: candidate 73626946-3c7c-5885-839e-5a57171c3f04 (node 4ac5d391-be0c-5798-95d7-2e5fbf243e59); matrix form also legible on the same page.

render_note: The book states its own Fig. 5.4 example used 'five affine transformations, which themselves were somewhat arbitrarily chosen' but does not print their coefficients on this page — only the general law (eq-1) and one single-map illustration (eq-2) are page-verified. The actual render therefore instantiates eq-1 with the canonical, independently published N=3 Sierpinski-triangle coefficients (Hutchinson 1981; Barnsley, Fractals Everywhere, 1988), not a re-transcription of this specific book's unlisted Fig. 5.4 set. See render-brief parameter_envelope for exact values and this distinction.
